claims.citation: New York Herald, 11 September 1866, p. 8, col. 6
claims.verbatim:
Steamship Hecla (Br), Edmonson, Liverpool Aug 28, via
Queenstown 29th, with mdse and 419 passengers, to E Cu-
nard. Has had strong westerly winds the entire passage.
Aug 29, 10:30 PM, spoke brig Hibernia, bound up Channel;
Sept 5, 10 AM, 240 miles E of Cape Race, exchanged signals
with bark Princess, of Liverpool, bound W; 7th, 6 PM, lat 42
47, lon 60 20, passed steamship Persia, hence for Liverpool;
9th, 2:20 PM, 240 miles E of Sandy Hook, steamship Napo-
leon III, hence for Havre.
